d: The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is bp Upstream’s embedded delivery capability. We forward-deploy AI-enabled data scientists and engineers directly into an operating region, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the business to solve real problems in days, not quarters — and to validate the value before investment is committed. Each team member owns solutions end-to-end (the person who frames the problem is the person who ships and sustains it), builds deep domain knowledge in-region, and works alongside AI tooling to punch far beyond the weight of a small team. It is a federated model: centrally governed, locally executed, and AI-enabled by design.

As a Data Scientist in the FDE team, you are embedded with one of bp’s Upstream operating regions, working alongside experienced data scientists and business customers to build and deliver data science and AI solutions to real operational problems. You’ll take ownership of well-defined pieces of work — from exploring live data and building models through to helping users adopt what you’ve built — and grow quickly into owning solutions end-to-end. With AI tooling, the Foundry Fellowship and hands-on coaching behind you, this is a role for someone who wants to learn fast, ship real things and see their work make a difference. Put simply, your job is to help turn data into decisions.
This is a fresh graduate opportunity for Omani nationals looking to start their career in data science and AI.
q: Hands-on experience in data science, machine learning or analytics (including internships, placements, graduate schemes or relevant postgraduate research).
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, physics) or equivalent practical experience.
Solid programming skills in Python (and/or R) and SQL, with experience building models and working with real-world data.
A grounding in core statistics and machine learning methods, and the curiosity to apply them to messy, practical problems.
The ability to communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences and work collaboratively with business stakeholders.
A customer-centric, pragmatic mindset with a bias for delivering value and a willingness to take ownership.
A strong learning mindset — open to feedback, comfortable with ambiguity and keen to use AI tooling to accelerate delivery.
Experience with Palantir Foundry (Ontology, AIP) — helpful, but this will be built in role through the Foundry Fellowship and on-the-job coaching.
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot).
Exposure to cloud platforms, version control and basic MLOps / productionisation practice.
Interest in, or exposure to, operational Upstream domains (production, operations, maintenance & reliability, wells, subsurface or procurement).
Experience energy industry is nice to have.
Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role
This role is not eligible for relocation
This position is a hybrid of office/remote working

d: Manage governance, risk management, and compliance activities across construction programs and projects to ensure adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and industry best practices.

Support the establishment and maintenance of effective governance frameworks, risk controls, compliance monitoring processes, and assurance activities that promote project integrity, transparency, and operational excellence.
Drive proactive risk identification, compliance oversight, and governance reporting to support successful project delivery and organizational objectives.

PMP, PMI-RMP, CRMP, CIA, CISA, ISO 31000, or equivalent professional certification preferred
6-10 years of progressive experience in governance, risk management, compliance, construction controls, audit, project management, or related disciplines
Supporting governance and compliance activities within large-scale construction, infrastructure, real estate, or capital project environments
Conducting risk assessments, compliance reviews, and assurance activities
Developing governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and control mechanisms
Working with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, consultants, and regulatory stakeholders
Preparing governance reporting, risk analysis, and executive-level presentations
r: Implement and maintain construction governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks across assigned projects and programs
Monitor compliance with organizational policies, governance requirements, regulatory obligations, and project controls standards
Facilitate risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and risk monitoring activities across construction portfolios
Conduct governance reviews, compliance assessments, audits, and assurance activities to evaluate adherence to established requirements
Track and report governance, compliance, and risk management performance indicators and key metrics

d: We are looking for experienced MEP Project Managers to oversee the execution and delivery of mid-to-high-rise residential projects. The ideal candidates should have a strong track record of managing large-scale MEP projects, leading site teams, resolving execution challenges, and ensuring projects are delivered on schedule and successfully handed over.
The role focuses on project execution, site management, team leadership, coordination, and overall project delivery rather than detailed design engineering.
q: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 7 years of experience specifically in MEP Project Management.
Ideally 10–15 years of overall professional experience; strong candidates with 10–12 years will also be considered.
Proven experience managing mid-to-high-rise residential MEP projects.
Must have successfully delivered at least two MEP projects through final handover.
Experience managing large-scale MEP project scopes, with exposure to projects valued at AED 70 million or above.
Strong experience in site execution, project coordination, manpower management, and stakeholder handling.
Ability to manage project challenges, drive progress, and ensure timely project completion.
r: Lead and manage the execution of MEP works across mid-to-high-rise residential projects.
Ensure project delivery in accordance with approved designs, specifications, contractual requirements, and project timelines.
Oversee day-to-day site operations and coordinate with engineering, construction, procurement, and subcontractor teams.
Manage project resources, manpower, materials, and subcontractors to ensure efficient execution.
Identify and resolve site-related challenges, technical issues, and project bottlenecks.
Coordinate with consultants, main contractors, clients, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth project progress.
Monitor project schedules, budgets, quality standards, and overall performance.
Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and applicable project standards.
Lead project teams and drive timely completion, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
